evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Since most user-specific tasks do not require the breadth of frontier models, a practical solution is to adapt a shared on-device model into lightweight specialists.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: With specialists of only 1-5 MB that update 0.015-0.05% of the parameters, MobileSpec raises the success rate of a phone-use agent from 6-23% up to 89-100% and trains a personalized 8B model on an iPhone 16 Pro overnight.
